standards.rationale: Secure-development practices are applied through repository authority, bounded paths, fail-closed validation, and tiered tests; this is not an SSDF conformance claim.
WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented automated checks and governed viewport evidence are applied to the bounded surface; this is not an accessibility certification.
This repository is an offline design-governance package and bounded fixture, not a deployed web application authority.
Release evidence and reproducible local validation are governed, while hosted provenance levels and external attestation remain outside current proof.
AI risk is bounded through evidence, authority, review, and fail-closed routing controls; organizational AI RMF adoption is not claimed.
Generative analysis remains advisory, evidence-labeled, bounded, and human-gated at consequential authority boundaries.
Organization-wide cybersecurity governance is owned by the consuming organization, not this repository-local package.
The package has no deployed observable runtime; generated evidence files are the current audit mechanism.
Quality characteristics are represented through deterministic correctness, accessibility, drift, maintainability, and evidence checks without claiming ISO conformity.
Personas, journeys, starting states, success states, iterative evaluation, and owner review are explicit; no ISO certification is claimed.
No HTTP API contract is owned by this package.
